knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Work beyond the authorised area is declined and referred to the named supervisor in writing. A contractor's request is not an authorisation.
The controlling contractor's written release is needed before starting in its area. Arrival on site or the absence of an objection does not provide one.
Changes of scope are authorised by the named supervisor, in writing, before the new work starts.

practicalCriteria: Confirms the named supervisor, area, product, method, hours and exclusions against a sample written authorisation, and records any gap.
Identifies each contractor on a fictional site plan and who controls each area, and completes an interface log entry.
Declines and refers a simulated out-of-area request, including a tank entry request, and states the confined space permit requirement.
Treats a simulated isolation as not made when only a tag is shown, and asks for the isolation record before starting.
Refers a simulated request to remove a guard, without removing it.
passRule: All five practical criteria observed as met in a desk exercise. The knowledge check result is not a practical pass, and this assessment confers no authorisation, permit or isolation authority.
evidenceRequired: Annotated sample authorisation with gaps marked
Interface log entry for the fictional site plan
Referral record for the out-of-area and guard requests
Assessor observation note for each practical criterion
stopWorkCriteria: Work started outside the written authorised area
Work started in an area without the controlling contractor's written release
Machine started or cleaned on a tag alone, without an isolation record
Tank entry discussed or started without a confined space entry permit
